name: 4 Subtask Panel Designs for ChatView
description:
Here's a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The user requested that the **subtasks cards section** in `ChatView.vue` be made collapsible.
2. The existing `Collapsible.vue` component was already available, supporting slots for `icon`, `title`, `summary`, and `actions`.
3. `Collapsible` was imported and registered in `ChatView.vue`, wrapping the kanban-style subtask card strip.
4. Named slots were used to show the **layer-group icon**, subtask count title, column distribution pills (only when collapsed), and a quick-add button always visible in the header.
5. A `subtasksOpen` data property was added to track collapse state and conditionally render the summary pills in the `#summary` slot.

messages.content:
It's usefull to see all available subtasks when working with chats witth multiple sub tasks. Create 4 different designs for chat with multiple sub tasks.
Each code block with the design must have same file name for easy testing
